headline: Quanta System Goes Live: Quanta Replaces Dollar Across Meridian Zone
body: At midnight last night, the Quanta Currency Consortium formally activated the quanta ledger network across the Meridian zone, marking the official end of the US dollar as legal tender in the region's fourteen provisional governance districts. The transition, two years in the making, converts all registered accounts at a flat rate of 1 quanta per 840 legacy dollars — a ratio calibrated to the dollar's final tradeable value before Federal Remnant hyperinflation rendered it functionally worthless last autumn. Consortium director Piotr Vasquez-Cheng confirmed that 94 percent of registered businesses had completed migration, though he acknowledged that large segments of The Narrows, The Shelf, and Old Harbor populations remain unbanked and will require manual conversion at Quanta distribution nodes over the coming months. Critics, including early voices from what would become The Collective, warn that the corponation-controlled consortium gives private interests veto power over monetary supply — a concern Vasquez-Cheng dismissed as 'economic nostalgia.'
aftermath: Quanta rapidly became the dominant currency of Meridian 88, though the Iron Lotus and Bore Rats developed a parallel barter-and-scrip economy in unregistered districts that persists to the present day, functioning as a shadow financial system beyond Quanta oversight.
runner_relevance: The currency transition created immediate demand for runners skilled in financial logistics — courier contracts paying 200 to 800 quanta moved physical Quanta access tokens to unbanked communities before rival criminal operations could intercept the supply chain. The Iron Lotus simultaneously hired extraction teams to acquire Quanta node authentication keys, seeking leverage over the new financial infrastructure before it fully hardened. Smuggling contracts also proliferated as residents of unregistered districts paid runners to convert legacy dollar hoards through off-grid black market exchanges operating out of The Underworld.
